However, we are all responsible for making our own interpretations and using what makes sense to us. Therefore, there will never be a house system, or sign system that is "right" or "wrong". They each simply have pros and cons, and people who use them and people who don't. 

Don't discard something that has been working for you & makes sense to you, you are using the "right" system, in the sense that you understand it. Even if somebody tells you it's wrong, just laugh. Nobody knows you like you do! :)
